==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) I traveled to a post apocalyptic fantasy world. (This was inspired by playing the beginning of the game ""Forspoken"" on 11/06/2025 shortly before bed.) Using Upsight, I learned that the Storyverse was flooded long ago and this world was a casualty. (I first used Upsight in a dream on 11/01/2025. This is the first time Upsight has been used to view information from the past, rather than in the future.) Whatever threat caused this must have been extremely overpowered. (The exact nature of the cause of the flood is unclear, but I imagine it to have been some kind of water elemental with divine malevolence. I don't know if said elemental still exists somewhere in the Storyverse. Looking through my logs, I don't think I've ever fought a water elemental before. Back on 07/17/2025, I had a dream where I theorized that there are demonic elementals known as ""The Endless"". These beings possess godlike abilities, and I have battled multiple in the past. I don't think I've ever fought one that has posed a threat to the entire Storyverse before.)
